session_id.description: Optional conversation session identifier. Generated by server if omitted.

messages.description: Sequential message history for multi-turn dialogue.

scope.description: Scope of the conversation: 'global' across all incidents, or 'incident' focused on a single incident.

incident_id.description: Target incident identifier when scope is 'incident'.

evidence_crop_ids.description: Optional list of evidence item identifiers (e.g. I1, E1) for focused visual QA.

context.description: Optional conversational context specifying scope, target incident, or evidence crops.

version_id.description: Optional report revision (report_revisions.id) the question is about. Citations come from that revision: the search index for the official one, the revision's own saved evidence for any other.

draft_report.description: Optional unsaved incident report edited from version_id. Requires version_id. Citations are grounded in its entities, instruments and assets, with crops taken from the same item in version_id.
